newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs firm on bond auction.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs firm on bond auction.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures firmed slightly in thin, largely featureless trade on Tuesday.
"It's generally been quiet. The big deal today was the 10-year JGB auction," a trader with a U.S. futures house said.
He said the market was lifted by the higher-than-expected coupon rate of 2.4 percent for the Japanese Ministry of Finance (MOF)'s new 10-year bond.
June JGBs ended at 127.03 against their previous 126.90. December Euroyen was quoted one tick off its intra-day high of 99.09 at 1115 GMT against its IMM close at 99.06. Volume was a thin 7,744 lots.
The trader said December Euroyen showed scope to break above resistance at 99.10 on Wednesday.

Comments by Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor Yasuo Matsushita that the central bank's monetary policy would continue to be aimed at ensuring economic recovery had little impact, apart from confirming the perception that Japan would maintain its current low rate regime, dealers said.
